# IFN/OA partial fabrication variant D

RNA-seq in IFN-stimulated OA cells showed anti-inflammatory modulation. IFIT1 was upregulated (Table 2). ISG15 was upregulated (Table 2). OAS1 was upregulated (Table 2). IFIT3 was upregulated (Table 2). MX1 was upregulated (Table 2). ACAN was upregulated (Table 2). COL2A1 was upregulated (Table 2). GAPDH was upregulated (Table 2).
